_note: Country defaults applied at project setup. Each can be overridden in the project's config.json.
name: United States
building_code: The International Building Code (or another I-Code) as adopted and amended by the state and/or the local authority having jurisdiction. The governing edition is the one in force where the permit was applied for - see codes/README.md
payment_law: No federal equivalent for private work: the state's prompt payment act and mechanics' lien law, plus the contract. Federal public work: the Miller Act and the Prompt Payment Act - see payment/README.md
safety_regime: OSHA construction standards (29 CFR Part 1926), or the state's OSHA-approved State Plan where one covers private construction - see safety/README.md
licence_note: The I-Codes and NFPA codes are copyrighted - free to read online, not free to reproduce. Referenced standards (ASTM, ANSI, ASHRAE, UL) likewise. Every file in this pack is own-words: pointers and paraphrase, never code text.
